stateSemantics.BLOCKED: A required proof cannot be produced inside the slice; blocks the freeze and requires a structured QUESTION.
stateSemantics.IN_PROGRESS: Work started, required evidence not yet complete or not yet bound to the current commit.
stateSemantics.NOT_STARTED: No product change and no evidence produced yet.
stateSemantics.PROVEN: The evidence named in requiredEvidence exists, is bound to the current commit and is contradiction-free.

evidenceDiscipline.note: Every baselineObservation in this file is candidate discovery per TLP-009. No removal, reachability or dispensability conclusion is derived from it. Each item names the semantic layers that must be evaluated before its status may become PROVEN.
semanticLayers: conditional compilation across every retained TFM
reflection, dependency injection and serializer registration
pack closure and external consumer compile

items.subject: Git baseline and recovery branch
items.baselineObservation: Measured at start: HEAD 1c6fe74b, tree a73caf70, working tree clean (0 porcelain lines). refs/heads/main and refs/remotes/origin/main both 1c6fe74b. Annotated tag baseline/servicebus-takeover-2026-08-13 is tag object 52b6faed and dereferences to 1c6fe74b. Branch cleanup/servicebus-net10-recovery created from 1c6fe74b, 0 commits ahead, old branch is not an ancestor.
plannedSemanticProof: Re-derive at freeze: rev-parse of HEAD, main, origin/main, tag object and tag^{commit}.
git merge-base --is-ancestor baseline HEAD must succeed for the freeze commit.
Assert tag object identity 52b6faed is byte-unchanged and still points at the baseline commit.
Assert refs/heads/main and refs/remotes/origin/main are still exactly the baseline commit.
Assert no rebase or history rewrite: the baseline commit object and tree are still reachable and unmodified.
Full freeze diff and removal manifest generated exactly against 1c6fe74b.
risks: Local refs cannot prove the state of the real remote. origin/main is a remote-tracking ref; a genuine remote statement needs a read-only git ls-remote and network access.
The repository carries three pre-existing stash entries and ignored build/evidence outputs from earlier work packages. They are not part of the baseline tree and must not be modified or cleaned.

items.subject: Aborted cleanup branch and its commit history
items.baselineObservation: cleanup/servicebus-net10 is at e5900afd with exactly 89 commits ahead of the baseline, matching the matrix. The baseline is an ancestor of it; it is not an ancestor of the recovery branch.
plannedSemanticProof: Ancestry proof at freeze: e5900afd must not be an ancestor of the recovery HEAD and no recovery commit may list an old-branch commit as parent.
Commit-history scan of the recovery branch: English messages only, no inherited German or mixed history.
Old branch tip must still be exactly e5900afd at freeze.
Forensic patch-id census against the old branch is reported as comparison information only, never as a source of change.
risks: Independently reconstructed changes can produce patch-ids identical to old-branch commits, because both follow the same normative requirement. Identity of a patch-id is therefore not evidence of a cherry-pick and must be explained rather than avoided.

items.subject: PO-authorized keep/remove project matrix

The retained set of REQ-CLEAN-003 maps to exactly 20 baseline src projects; 13 src projects are removal candidates (Azure.Cosmos, DapperIntegration, EntityFrameworkIntegration, MartenIntegration, MongoDbIntegration, NHibernateIntegration, RedisIntegration, HangfireIntegration, KafkaIntegration, WebJobs.EventHubsIntegration, WebJobs.ServiceBusIntegration, Interop.NServiceBus, Newtonsoft).
plannedSemanticProof: Evaluated MSBuild project graph before and after (restore graph plus -graph build) rather than solution text.
Removal manifest listing every removed project path with its exclusive closure.
Negative probe: a retained project still referencing a removed project must fail the build; the clean graph must restore and build green.
Pack census: the produced package set equals the authorized retained set.
Test census maps every test project to a retained or removed subject.
risks: The retained count of 20 covers baseline projects only. REQ-CLEAN-005 additionally requires an analyzer/code-fix split with a non-shipping pack project, so the final project count is legitimately higher; this must be stated rather than silently reconciled.
Shared or linked Compile items can keep a removed project's source compiled elsewhere. Deletion must be proven through evaluated Compile item lists, not through file removal.

items.baselineObservation: Directory.Build.props pins <LangVersion>12</LangVersion> and sets <NoWarn>CS1591,CS1998</NoWarn> repository-wide. The analyzer project is the only netstandard2.0 project. Local LangVersion=latest and test-wide CS0618 occurrences still to be evaluated.
plannedSemanticProof: Evaluated MSBuild property per project and TFM after removal, proving the SDK-derived default rather than a text deletion.

Warning-suppression scan for global CS1998 and test-wide CS0618, with justified local suppressions only.

If the netstandard2.0 analyzer genuinely requires a newer language feature, stop with the exact compiler diagnostic instead of introducing any pin.

Removing a test-wide CS0618 suppression conflicts with F-SB-02, which keeps the obsolete API in this slice. The resolution must be a locally justified suppression, never removal of the obsolete surface.

crossCuttingRisks.statement: REQ-CLEAN-006 requires every retained external adapter to run its full behavior scope against a genuinely representative ephemeral counterpart, and keeps the whole freeze open when one is missing. Container runtime, AWS and Azure availability on the execution host is therefore the single largest freeze risk and is measured before the corresponding work blocks start.

The reference point of the CHANGELIST must be unambiguous between the pinned upstream MassTransit version and the ViciOne takeover baseline, because the identity rename already turned nearly every path into a rename. An ambiguity here is resolved by QUESTION, not by choosing one.

The matrix cites E01 as structure owner, but the active architecture index contains only A00 to A14. Structure is therefore derived from REQ-CLEAN-005 and the explicit path list of REC-018; anything not derivable from those is a QUESTION.

Several numbers in the matrix describe the aborted branch or an earlier lead measurement, not the baseline. Measured deviations, such as zero tracked TestResults in the baseline and a different Newtonsoft reference split, are reported to the Lead and the fresh measurement governs the work.

Removing the test-wide CS0618 suppression collides with F-SB-02, which keeps the remaining obsolete API in this slice. The only admissible resolution is a locally justified suppression at the affected callsites.
